title: Round-trip identity — atomic heading with a local style + a global-class ref (R4/R5)
_comment: WP-Q05 (14-fixtures-harness.md §7). An e-heading carrying BOTH a local style (in `styles`, mirrored into `classes` per R4/§5.1) AND a global-class id reference (g-roundtrip) in the same `classes` array. build → get_structure → normalize(both) → assert structural equality. CRITICAL (C2/R5, spike S02): on save the ELEMENT id AND the dependent LOCAL-STYLE id are BOTH re-minted (local-style ids are NOT stable across save). The round-trip test therefore builds a structural id-map that remaps element ids AND local-style ids (the `styles` key, the StyleDefinition.id, and the mirrored entry in `classes.value`) positionally before comparing — never literal ids. The GLOBAL-class id `g-roundtrip` is a stable external reference and is preserved verbatim. Local-style variant props (color/size envelopes) are content and survive. _cssid stripped; empty sibling keys dropped. Run as ADMIN (content-sanitizer exempt). prefilter.verdict:defer (style props non-trivial; PHP dry_run authoritative). NB: requires the `g-roundtrip` global class to exist on the target (design-classes vertical) — the live half feature-detects and skips if absent.
